en.name: Dried wood ear (black fungus)
en.summary: Dried wood ear keeps 6–12 months airtight in a cool dark cupboard — a general figure for dried vegetables rather than one published for fungus. The part that really matters is the soaking: no more than two hours at room temperature, and in the refrigerator if it needs longer, because badly soaked black fungus can develop a toxin that cooking does not destroy.
en.pantry: Airtight, dark and dry, 6–12 months. Understand where that range comes from: it is the general shelf life given for dried vegetables — roughly half a year in a cool room, only a few months in a warm one, and up to a year at ordinary room temperature depending on which source you follow — and no authority has published a figure for wood ear itself. The dried ears are brittle and crumble into shards that absorb damp quickly, so keep them in a rigid sealed jar with the desiccant sachet rather than in an opened bag.
en.fridge: There is no refrigerated shelf life for soaked wood ear, and this is the one entry on the site where that absence is the point. Hong Kong's food safety authority says soaking should take no more than two hours at room temperature, and that black fungus must be kept in the refrigerator if it needs to soak overnight. The reason is specific: improperly soaked and stored black fungus can develop bongkrekic acid, and cooking does not destroy it. So soak cold, soak short, refrigerate the bowl if it will be long, use the fungus at once, and throw it out if it turns slimy or smells wrong. Never soak a batch on the counter all day and cook it that evening.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for wood ear, dried or soaked. Freezing the dried ears adds little to a product that keeps for months sealed and whose enemy is moisture, and freezing soaked ears destroys the crunch that is the only reason to use them. Cooked dishes containing wood ear freeze acceptably in portions. Nothing about freezing addresses the soaking hazard — the only control for that is time and temperature during the soak.
spoilage: Soaked fungus that has turned slimy, slippery or sticky.
Any sour, fermented or otherwise abnormal smell after soaking.
Musty smell, damp softness or visible mould on the dried ears.
Soaking water that has gone cloudy, foamy or smells off.
tips: Soak in cold water for no more than two hours at room temperature.
Put the bowl in the fridge for any longer soak, including overnight.
Use soaked fungus immediately; do not soak in the morning for dinner on the counter.
Store the dried ears in a rigid airtight jar with the desiccant sachet.

faq.q: How long does dried wood ear keep?
faq.a: 6–12 months airtight in a cool dark cupboard. That is the general figure for dried vegetables, not one published for wood ear.

faq.q: How long can black fungus be soaked?
faq.a: No more than two hours at room temperature. If it needs longer, or overnight, the bowl goes in the refrigerator.

faq.q: Why is soaking black fungus a safety issue?
faq.a: Improperly soaked and stored black fungus can develop bongkrekic acid, which cooking does not destroy. Soak cold and short, use it at once, and discard anything slimy or off-smelling.

zh.name: 黑木耳（乾）
zh.summary: 乾黑木耳密封放陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 6～12 個月——這是乾燥蔬菜的通則數字，不是為木耳公布的。真正要緊的是泡發：室溫下不超過兩小時，需要更久就放冰箱，因為泡發與保存不當的黑木耳可能產生一種加熱也破壞不了的毒素。
zh.pantry: 密封、避光、乾燥，6～12 個月。這個範圍的來歷要說清楚：它是乾燥蔬菜的一般保存期限——依不同資料，涼爽室溫下約半年、溫暖環境只有幾個月、一般室溫下最多一年——而針對木耳本身，沒有任何單位公布過數字。乾木耳又脆又容易碎，碎片吸濕特別快，所以請用硬殼氣密罐連同乾燥劑保存，而不是留在開過的塑膠袋裡。
zh.fridge: 泡發後的黑木耳沒有冷藏保存期限，而在這一則裡，「沒有期限」本身就是重點。香港的食物安全單位指出，泡發在室溫下不應超過兩小時，而如果需要泡過夜，黑木耳必須放進冰箱。理由很具體：泡發與存放不當的黑木耳可能產生米酵菌酸（bongkrekic acid），而加熱並不會把它破壞掉。所以：用冷水泡、時間要短、要泡久就把碗放冰箱、泡好立刻使用，一旦變黏滑或聞起來不對就丟掉。絕對不要早上放在流理台泡一整天、晚上再煮。
zh.freezer: 不論乾的還是泡開的黑木耳，都沒有公布的冷凍期限。把乾木耳冷凍，對一個密封就能放好幾個月、敵人是水分的東西幫助有限；把泡開的冷凍則會毀掉它唯一的價值——脆度。含木耳的熟菜分小份冷凍還算可以。但冷凍完全無助於泡發的風險：唯一的控制手段，是泡發過程中的時間與溫度。
spoilage: 泡開後變得黏滑、滑手或發黏。
泡發後出現任何酸味、發酵味或其他異味。
乾木耳有霉味、受潮發軟，或看得到霉。
泡的水變混濁、起泡或聞起來不對。
tips: 用冷水泡，室溫下不要超過兩小時。
需要泡更久、包括泡過夜，一律把碗放冰箱。
泡好立刻使用，不要早上泡、放在檯面上等到晚餐。
乾木耳用硬殼氣密罐加乾燥劑保存。

faq.a: 密封放陰涼暗處約 6～12 個月。這是乾燥蔬菜的通則數字，不是木耳專屬的公布資料。
室溫下不要超過兩小時。需要更久或要泡過夜，就把碗放進冰箱。

faq.q: 為什麼泡黑木耳是安全問題？
faq.a: 泡發與存放不當的黑木耳可能產生米酵菌酸，而加熱無法破壞它。請冷水短泡、泡好立刻使用，黏滑或有異味就丟掉。
